Author: Jack Luxear
Name: GatherBuddy Ascended
Description: Adds commands to simplify gathering by finding nodes and fish and their locations via item name and a UI to keep track of special uptime and weather conditions. Also automatically gathers items based on these conditions using lists that you specify. Automated gathering requires vnavmesh.
Punchline: Simplify Gathering and Fishing to the extreme.
Changelog:
GatherBuddy Ascended 3.0.0.0

• Added craft-list material acquisition planning for unlocked vendors and marketboards, with purchase estimates, maximum Gil budgets, HQ/NQ and source preferences, multi-world routing, and fail-closed currency and unlock checks.
• Marketplace automation is currently experimental and will not automatically buy items.
• Added persistent Marketplace buy lists, Universalis price caching, current-world filtering, typo-tolerant search, and improved marketplace and vendor navigation.
• Added Gabriel, a stochastic Expert-recipe solver with per-item selection, configurable worker threads, and faithful full-quality chance estimates that queue around active crafts.
• Improved Donatello and Raphael solver speed, replanning, live-state recovery, low-level Inner Quiet tracking, and quality-focused plan selection.
• Added automatic desynthesis, continuation of manually selected gatherables, material-list sharing, and clearer pre-craft dependency visibility.
• Added configurable AFK prevention while automation is active, enabled by default.
• Added cordial strength ordering, HQ/NQ preference, an option to avoid wasting GP recovery above the cap, and default-on use of every gathering attempt on timed collectables.
• Improved collectable and aetherial-reduction planning performance, fuzzy collectable matching, and expected scrip-yield optimization.
• Improved gathering-node navigation and interaction reliability: missing nodes no longer cause repeated movement in place, failed interactions are retried safely, and nodes are only marked complete after a confirmed gathering session.
• Improved auto-crafting and auto-gathering flow, including retainer restocking, material deficits, class selection, repair, navigation, queue recovery, and manual-craft takeover.
• Added earlier errors for missing crafting jobs, gearsets, recipe and gathering unlocks, unavailable vendors, currencies, and travel requirements.
• Fixed marketplace estimate performance, auto-gather state races, crafting-list edge cases, specialist actions, quality selection, search, navigation, gathering attempts, and cleanup bugs.
